rationale: REPLACE_WITH_OWNER_RATIONALE -- codex/launch-a imports the reviewed codex/phase3-operations-wallet, codex/p3-held-decouple, and codex/p3-preflight-v4 backend lineages plus the website source (PR #1, db88106a) as single-parent/canonical-descendant commits onto canonical main. Five of the six changed control-surface files below carry content changes from the reviewed imports or their necessary CI-admission follow-ups (the zero-before/parentless-push fix in control-gate.yml/identity-gate.yml/v4-gates.yml via scripts/ci/push-range.mjs, a new read-only pull_request fork-proof job proving the exact PR head instead of only the final main push, and the seed-intent binding hash update to RobinhoodV4ArchiveFork.t.sol). scripts/verify-control-dependencies.mjs carries three A-authored changes on top of the import: admitting '.github/workflows/web-ci.yml' and '.github/workflows/deploy-web.yml' into PERMITTED_WORKFLOW_PATHS with the actions/setup-node pin, the matching SUPPORTED_V4_GATES_WORKFLOW_SHA256/SUPPORTED_FORK_PROOF_WORKFLOW_SHA256 bumps, and stricter (not weaker) install-block coverage for the new fork-proof pull-request job. Verify all six digests against the actual diff (`git diff 37c0f955 <candidateTree> -- <path>` for each) before signing; this is the final, complete set for this branch -- no further control-surface edits are planned after this draft. Separately: apps/web (G's own content, not touched by A1) still fails the cleanroom scanner's historical-architecture rule in several files with genuinely obsolete retired-chain and retired-bridge-protocol claims -- that is G's fix to make, not part of this pin bump, and not blocked by it.
activationNote: Verified by direct code inspection of scripts/verify-control-dependencies.mjs's baseCheckerPinBumpErrors: this record's controlGatePinBump would need to be embedded, verbatim, inside product/dependency-verification.json AT the exact commit that CI checks out as the PR/push head (candidateTree). candidatePinsSha256 above only covers product/dependency-pins.json's bytes, so that part is stable and reusable, but candidateTree is the full commit SHA of whatever the actual PR head is at CI time -- the commit that adds this signed record necessarily changes that commit's own tree, which changes its own resulting SHA, so a commit cannot correctly state its own SHA inside itself. This is a structural property of the current activation protocol, not something A can satisfy by construction. The owner has rejected a ruleset bypass as the resolution (green applicable checks are required, no ruleset weakening). The durable fix is an owner-authorized control-plane migration replacing the self-referential commit binding with a deterministic approved-content binding (for example the dependency-pin digest plus the enumerated control-blob digests already in `controls` above) -- that migration is itself a root-of-trust decision requiring separate owner authorization before A implements it, not something to design or land unilaterally.
recommendedResolution: Await the owner's trust-root migration decision (tracked separately by the coordinator) before any further action on this specific record. A did not and will not set approvalToken to "OWNER APPROVED" itself, and will not implement a protocol change here without that separate authorization.
